en.headline: Sha Tin driver arrested after crash and false robbery report
en.dek: Police say a 37-year-old man crashed into a barrier at Lung Hang Estate, fled, then claimed he had been robbed; officers found suspected drugs in the car.
body: A 37-year-old man was arrested in Sha Tin on Monday night on suspicion of trafficking in dangerous drugs and misleading a police officer after a private car struck a barrier at Lung Hang Estate and he later reported a robbery that officers said did not match the facts.

Police said a security guard at the estate reported at about 9.25pm that a private car had crashed into a gate or railing outside Wing Sam House. The driver and a male passenger of about 40 left the scene on foot.

Officers later received a report from the driver, surnamed Lam, that he had been robbed by three men at the estate. They found him on Tsuen Nam Road in Tai Wai. After initial inquiries, police said his account appeared to be false and that he was suspected of giving misleading information.

A search of the abandoned car found 16 vape cartridges suspected of containing etomidate, commonly known as space oil, plus small amounts of suspected cocaine and crystal methamphetamine. The market value of the drugs was still being assessed. Lam was detained by Sha Tin District Criminal Investigation Team 6. The passenger had not been arrested.

zh.headline: 沙田隆亨部私家車撞閘 司機報假劫案兼藏毒被捕
zh.dek: 警方指37歲男子在榮心樓外撞欄後逃走，其後報稱遭3人行劫，調查後認為與事實不符，並在車內檢獲懸疑毒品。
body: 一名37歲男子星期一晚在沙田隆亨部涉交通意外後報稱遇劫，警方調查後認為其陳述與事實不符，並在肇事私家車內檢獲懸疑毒品，以涉嫌販運危險藥物及誤導警務人員將他拘捕。
警方表示，晚上約9時25分接獲屋部保安報案，指一輛私家車在榮心樓外撞向車閘或鐵欄，司機及一名約40歲男乘客其後徒步離開現場。
其後該名姓林司機報案，聲稱在上址懸疑遭3名男子行劫。人員在大圍村南道尋獲林男，初步調查後相信報案內容與事實不符，懸疑他蓄意提供虛假資料及誤導調查。
警方搜查涉事車輛，檢獲16粒懸疑含有依托咪酯的電子煙煙彈，以及少量懸疑可卡因及冰毒，市值有待點算。林男正被沙田警區刑事調查隊第六隊扣留調查，男乘客仍未被拘捕。
